open_questions.gap: The primary objective was spoken as a garbled token («μπραντ αγουέρνες»), proposed as "brand awareness"; the intended term is not confirmed.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The lead objective drives the whole brief, so it must not rest on an unconfirmed transcription.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε ότι ο βασικός στόχος είναι το brand awareness στη νέα κατηγορία; Υπάρχει και κάποιο μετρήσιμο επίπεδο που θέλετε να πετύχουμε;

open_questions.gap: The second objective is stated only as «δοκιμή, να μπει το προϊόν σε ντουλάπες»; it is unclear whether this means trial by consumers, retail sell-in, or something else.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Trial and store placement call for different activities and different success measures.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Όταν λέτε «δοκιμή, να μπει το προϊόν σε ντουλάπες», εννοείτε δοκιμή του προϊόντος από τους καταναλωτές ή είσοδο σε καταστήματα (sell-in);

open_questions.gap: No KPIs are defined: the client said they have not set KPIs yet and proposed building them together in the proposal.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without agreed success measures the campaign cannot be evaluated or the budget justified.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιοι είναι οι πρώτοι δείκτες επιτυχίας που έχετε στο μυαλό σας (sales, awareness, sell-in), ώστε να χτίσουμε τα KPIs πάνω τους στην πρόταση;

open_questions.gap: The CMO is reconsidering the positioning toward athleisure lifestyle; this is a personal view not yet locked with the board, and it differs from the positioning he says was written in the RFP.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Positioning determines the creative territory and the competitive set the campaign is judged against.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποια είναι η τελική τοποθέτηση για το Voreas Move: athleisure lifestyle ή τεχνική απόδοση; Πότε θα έχει αποφασίσει το board;

open_questions.gap: The hero video was spoken as a garbled token («χίρο βίντεο»), proposed as "hero video"; the intended term is not confirmed.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The hero video is the anchor deliverable, so its identity must be confirmed before scoping.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε ότι εννοείτε ένα hero video για το launch;

open_questions.gap: Social deliverables are described loosely (cutdowns, stories); formats, durations and quantities are undecided and left to the agency.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Production cost and timeline depend on the number, format and length of assets.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Υπάρχουν πλατφόρμες ή ποσότητες που θέλετε οπωσδήποτε στα social, ή προτιμάτε να σας προτείνουμε εμείς formats και διάρκειες;

open_questions.gap: The RFP's mid-March timing is only tentatively kept ("for now") and may move with the board's season discussion.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The launch date sets the production schedule and media booking.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Το «μέσα Μαρτίου» του RFP παραμένει η ημερομηνία του launch για την ώρα; Ποια είναι η πιο πρόσφατη εκτίμηση για το αν θα αλλάξει;

open_questions.gap: The date by which the launch timing will be known is given relative to the call date (2026-07-12).
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the date on which our planning assumptions can be locked.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Όταν λέτε «μέσα στον μήνα», εννοείτε έως τις 31 Ιουλίου 2026;

open_questions.gap: The approved figure is a hedged spoken amount with unstated currency and units, possibly up to a higher amount only if savings are found elsewhere (a conditional upper figure), and covers production and fees only.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The production budget bounds the scope of every deliverable.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε: το «κάπου στα εκατόν είκοσι, ίσως εκατόν είκοσι πέντε» είναι σε ευρώ, χωρίς ΦΠΑ, και καλύπτει μόνο production και αμοιβές; Τι θα χρειαστεί για να φτάσει στο υψηλότερο ποσό;

open_questions.gap: The media spend is held by the board and their media agency; no figure or order of magnitude was given, and the CFO declined to state one.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Channel mix and reach targets cannot be planned without knowing the media budget.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Με ποιον στη διοίκηση ή στη media εταιρεία μπορούμε να μιλήσουμε για το media spend, και πότε θα έχουμε τάξη μεγέθους;

open_questions.gap: Brand guidelines have not been received; the account lead said she will request them.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Brand rules and any mandatory elements cannot be captured until the guidelines are in hand.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Μπορείτε να μας στείλετε τα brand guidelines, μαζί με τυχόν υποχρεωτικά στοιχεία ή απαγορεύσεις για το launch;

internal_conflicts.note: Explicit, settled reversal: the same speaker retracts his own pop-up idea within seconds, citing cost, and the account lead records it as inactive at [00:12:10]. Kept as a trail only; not carried as a deliverable and no open question raised.
